notes: Exalted: The Sidereals supplied and intake in progress. 184 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/sidereal/inventory/: the character-creation overview (including the Ronin variant), the five Auspicious-Ability groups and Celestial Hierarchy minimums, the universal Anima Effect, all five Castes, the Arcane Fate signature trait mechanic and its Sidereal Anima Banner visibility/Paradox table, the Craft (Fate) Ability specialty, the altered/new Backgrounds, Chapter Five's general Charm framework (Manipulating Fate, Restricted/Unusual Charms, Prayer Strips, and more), and now all 25 of Chapter Five's Caste-and-Ability Charm trees in full across all five Castes (Journeys, Serenity, Battles, Secrets, Endings; 152 Charms total, including the Endings Caste's dedicated Violet Bier of Sorrows Martial Arts style). Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. The book's further secret Martial Arts styles taught to Sidereals generally (Charcoal March of Spiders, Prismatic Arrangement of Creation, Citrine Pox of Contagion), the full Colleges/astrology system, and Resplendent Destinies (pp. 215-218) are not yet inventoried. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
